Rule: Each observation needs official URL, retrieval time, published/as-of time, immutable content hash, entity/market ID and permission to use. Missing any required evidence blocks evaluation.
Features and quotes available no later than forecast cutoff; cutoff strictly before kickoff; results never features. Revisions retained separately.
Freeze strategy version, feature rules, selection threshold, market, folds, risk caps and trial family before test exposure. Log all rejected trials.
Train only before each complete test week; tune and calibrate inside training periods; embargo overlapping outcomes and keep all same-game legs in one fold.
Report Brier, log loss and reliability-bin sample counts against constant and no-vig market baselines on identical non-push observations. Push models evaluated separately.
Estimate continuous residual and binary hit-event correlations separately; report sample and uncertainty. Require a validated full joint model for three-plus legs.
Use archived executable quote at decision time, exact ticket/jurisdiction rules, line, price, void/push handling and costs; no retrospective best-price shopping.

Use paired week-block bootstrap for score improvement and net returns; use valid one-sided evidence tests and Holm family-wise correction over all registered trials. Do not equate p-values with probability of skill.
Pre-register power analysis, enough independent weeks, regime/season checks and drift limits. No universal sample count proves skill; report sensitivity to costs and model error.

All gates pass, independent final holdout remains untouched, and lower confidence bound on cost-adjusted return is positive. Rank by paired out-of-sample Brier improvement lower bound, then log loss, then drawdown.
Shadow-test frozen strategies on new games, monitor calibration and source freshness, stop on drift or missing data. Paper research only; no automatic wager placement.
